banner.title: flux-operator
banner.tagline: Runs the Flux Operator that owns the FluxInstance, so the Flux controllers are declared in one object and upgraded by one chart.

art.about: an operator that installs and upgrades Flux controllers
art.title: The Flux Operator

steps.title: Install
steps.text: Flux installs the flux-operator chart, which runs one Deployment and its CRDs in flux-system.
steps.scene: a sealed package unpacking into a single cube

steps.title: Reconcile
steps.text: The operator reads the FluxInstance named flux and installs or upgrades the controllers it declares.
steps.scene: a gear turning a stack of controller cards

steps.title: Admit
steps.text: A supplemental NetworkPolicy admits DNS replies, which the chart policy alone would drop.
steps.scene: a network node with a gate on one link

steps.title: Measure
steps.text: A ServiceMonitor scrapes the operator. The flux-instance alerts read the series that Flux exports.
steps.scene: a rising signal line over a dashboard grid
